headline: Zero-Install 8-Ball with Real Cue Spin Physics
text:
Need an 8-ball break without ads or downloads?

Built full spin mechanics, called pockets, & 3 AI tiers in pure vanilla JS—loads in 0.1s in your browser:

https://kreeda.games/break-room/index.html
